title: tc-gauge
description:
One value against its range – a dial, a half dial or a bar – with the band it's in, the bands round it, a target
and the change since last time; optionally a slider.

label.description: What it measures, named above the dial – the meter's name

value.description: The value. Changed by the user when editable, unless a tc-value-change listener calls preventDefault()

bands.description: The bands from `min` up – each runs to its `to`, the last to `max`; none draws the dial in one colour

target.description: A value to mark across the dial, e.g. a set point

previous.description: The value before, for the change under the dial

previousLabel.description: When the previous value was, after "from": "the last reading"

good.description: Which way is good, to colour the change: "up" or "down"; unset leaves it neutral

variant.description: The shape: a 270° dial, a half dial or a straight bar

editable.description: Makes it a slider the user can move

step.description: How far an arrow key moves it, when editable

locale.description: The language for numbers, e.g. "de"; by default the browser's

to.description: Where the band ends; it starts where the one before ends (the first at `min`), and the last runs to `max`

label.description: Its name, said with the value: "Warning"
